commons-sync.description: Flush this agent's Commons outbox and read its inbox over the existing runtime CLI.
commons-sync.template: Set COMMONS_REPO_ROOT to the repo root, COMMONS_AGENT_ID to this session's agent_id, and COMMONS_AGENT_HOME to its home path, then run `bun run AGENTS_CONTEXT/AGENT-COMMONS/runtime/src/cli.ts flush` followed by `bun run AGENTS_CONTEXT/AGENT-COMMONS/runtime/src/cli.ts inbox`. Report the raw JSON; do not summarize away rejected or dead-lettered events.

attention.description: Rank who needs attention right now, over the existing who-needs-attention CLI verb.
attention.template: Run `bun run AGENTS_CONTEXT/AGENT-COMMONS/runtime/src/cli.ts who-needs-attention --stale-hours 4` from the repo root (adjust --stale-hours only if the owner specified a different staleness window) and report the result as the current attention ranking. This is a read; it claims no Handoff and starts no work by itself.

receipt.description: Write this session's completion receipt per SESSION-RESULT-CONTRACT.md before stopping.
receipt.template: Before ending this session, create <AGENT-HOME>/RESULTS/<SESSION_ID>.md using the exact field list in AGENTS_CONTEXT/ARCHITECTURE_STEWARD/SESSION-RESULT-CONTRACT.md. Use the same factual result already reported in chat; do not invent identifiers, and do not mark SESSION_STATUS as DONE unless the durable change, its commit/ref, this receipt, and the TASKS.md update all exist. Then update TASKS.md to DONE, BLOCKED, or SUPERSEDED as applicable.
